description: This is a Python module implementing a Robot Framework test runner, which executes .robot test files from byte content, uploads artifacts to MinIO, and records results in a database. It includes functions for running tests in background, handling artifacts, parsing results, and updating the database.

methods.name: run_tests_background
methods.description: Runs a Robot Framework test suite from byte content, uploads artifacts, and records results in the database, intended to run in background tasks.

methods.name: _mark_run_status
methods.description: Updates the run status and timestamps in the database.

methods.name: _write_robot_file
methods.description: Writes the robot test content to a temporary file.

methods.name: _prepare_variable_list
methods.description: Converts variables dictionary into a list of CLI variable strings.

methods.name: _run_robot
methods.description: Executes the Robot Framework test suite and returns paths to output, log, and report files.

methods.name: _parse_results
methods.description: Parses the output.xml to extract test run summary statistics.

methods.name: _upload_artifacts
methods.description: Uploads output, log, and report files to MinIO storage.

methods.name: _insert_test_results
methods.description: Inserts individual test case results into the database.

methods.name: _finalize_run
methods.description: Marks the test run as completed in the database, including summary and artifacts.
